Prefer "Run Once for All Items" for aggregation, filtering, sorting, batches, transformations; use `$input.all()`. Choose "Run Once for Each Item" for independent logic; use `$input.item` or `$item`. Multiple items? "All Items"; independent items? "Each Item". Unsure? "All Items" (you can loop inside). Access via `$input.all()`, `$input.first()`, `$input.item`; specific nodes via `$node["Webhook"].json` or `$node["HTTP Request"].json`. Webhook data: `$json.body`.

Must return `[{json: {...}}]` format. Always return array of objects with `json` property. Even empty results must use the array/object format. Do not return an object without the array wrapper, an array without `json`, a plain string, raw `$input.all()` without mapping, or `{data: value}`. Always include a return statement; all code paths should return a consistent structure. Example: `return $input.all().map(item => ({json: item.json}));`

Use `map`/`filter` over manual loops; filter before expensive transformations. Guard missing/null data with optional chaining/guard clauses (`item.json?.user?.email`). D
